item.title: Roadblocks & Spec Gaps: Building TI-20260822-001
item.description: Written while authoring the Russia-nexus issue directly against both specs, no pipeline, the same way TI-20260817-001 was built. Every item below is something that actually happened during that process, not a hypothetical gap. 1. Non-US, non-English primary sources fail silently at Gate 2, and nothing distinguishes “unfetchable by this tool” from “unfetchable by anyone” CERT-UA’s advisory on UAC-0145 (the Sandworm fake-hiring campaign) is a real, named, dated document. It is not a private briefing or a deleted post, the two examples Gate 2 gives for a true grade-5 dead end.
